# Q2 Planning

Key goals for Q2:
- Launch new onboarding flow by end of April
- Improve activation rate from 42% to 55%
- Complete the data pipeline migration

The activation rate improvement is the most important lever. We've identified three root causes: confusing first-run experience, slow load times on mobile, and missing social proof on the signup page.
